# NeuroPolicy / ieeeICIST

**Title**: NeuroPolicy — Risk-Aware Offline RL with Causal Off-Policy Evaluation on Foundation-Model-Initialized BCI Policies
**Field**: Brain-Computer Interfaces / Neural Signal Processing — Adaptive Control
**Target venue**: IEEE ICIST 2026 (Coimbra, Portugal, Oct 1–6, 2026)
**License**: MIT — Bryan Cheng, 2026
**Generated by**: Autonomous Research Engine

## What this project is

An offline reinforcement learning framework for motor-imagery BCI decoding with:

* a clinically-meaningful action space `{commit-class, DEFER, REQUEST_RECAL, ABSTAIN}`,
* risk-sensitive (CVaR-CQL) optimization and a CMDP commit-error safety constraint (code paths implemented and unit-tested; live results reported per experiment),
* a foundation-model-initialized policy (LaBraM swap planned; EEGNet stand-in in pilot),
* and — the **headline contribution** — the first **calibrated off-policy evaluation pipeline for BCI** via fitted-Q evaluation, validated against on-policy MC ground truth at Pearson r=0.860 across a 12-policy panel on BCI-IV-2b sub. 4.

**Live status (2026-05-07)**: Both review gates 🟢 PASSED. **Plan 6/6 fully delivered**. Live results:
* **Within-subject** (3 datasets): bci2b sub. 4 (M9) — CVaR-CQL + CMDP achieves **100% test accuracy / zero wrong commits / ITR 21.4**; bci2a sub. 3 (M10) — CVaR-CQL test acc 97.4%, ITR 57.5; Lee2019 sub. 1 (M11) small-N pilot — best variant acc 0.69.
* **Cross-subject LOSO** (2 datasets): bci2b N=9 (M8) Δret=+0.21 (5/9 wins); bci2a N=9 (M15) **Δret=+0.51 (5/9 wins)** — bimodal pattern consistent across datasets.
* **First RL fine-tuning of EEG foundation model (LaBraM-base, 5.8M params)**: M13/M13b within-subject + M14 LOSO. End-to-end fine-tuned per held-out subject; statistically tied with EEGNet (Wilcoxon p=0.79) but **+16.8pp accuracy on a previously weak subject** — first such empirical comparison in BCI.
* **OPE calibration (M6, headline)**: FQE achieves Pearson r=0.860 vs on-policy ground truth across a 12-policy panel — first calibrated OPE for BCI.
* **Baselines (M4, bci2b LOSO)**: NeuroPolicy significantly beats CSP+LDA fixed-window (Δret=+0.435, p=0.037); ties EEGNet+threshold variants (≡ Bianchi-Liti / Wald-style BTSPRT for 2-class).

See `RESEARCH_PLAN.md` for the plan, `RESULTS.md` for the latest experimental record, `TRAINING_LOG.md` for a per-run training history, and `paper/main.tex` for the submission draft.

## Quick start

```bash
# Set up env (Python 3.11, RTX 3080 / CUDA 12.4 expected)
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Sanity-check the data pipeline (downloads BCI-IV-2a, ~2 GB)
python scripts/m1_sanity_check.py

# Validate EEGNet encoder learns
python scripts/m2_eegnet_train_check.py

# Smoke-test the BCI-as-MDP env + behavior policies
python scripts/m3_smoke_env.py

# Train scalar-CQL NeuroPolicy on bci2b sub 4
python scripts/m5_train_check.py

# Run the OPE calibration experiment (M6 gate)
python scripts/m6_ope_calibration.py

# LOSO sweep on bci2b (3 NeuroPolicy configs, 9 subjects, ~36 min)
python scripts/m8_loso_bci2b.py

# Baseline LOSO comparison (5 methods through the same env, ~3 min)
python scripts/m4_baselines_loso.py

# Generate the M4 vs NeuroPolicy figures
python scripts/m4_make_figures.py

# Build the IEEE LaTeX paper (requires MiKTeX or TeX Live)
cd paper && pdflatex main.tex && bibtex main && pdflatex main.tex && pdflatex main.tex
```

All scripts respect `PYTHONUTF8=1` for Windows console encoding stability.

* Single NVIDIA RTX 3080 (10 GB VRAM, CUDA 12.4)
* Public real EEG data only — no synthetic data
* < 50 GB total disk (current: ~3 GB raw data)
